answer: A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the vertex graph. Re-attestations are stored in basalt and velvet lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 13 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Verification costs 2 dollars and 1 days per identity, which turns a 2545 account sybil into a 3 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
